test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements regarding cricketer Jasprit Bumrah’s record at Edgbaston in 2022 are correct?

1) Indian captain Jasprit Bumrah broke Brian Lara's world record by scoring 32 runs in an over.

2) The world record stayed with Brian Lara for 18 years.

3) Brain Lara had hit South African left - arm spinner Robin Peterson for his record.

4) Jasprit Bumrah created a world record for maximum runs off a single over in Test cricket by hitting Stuart Broad for 35 runs.
solution:
The correct answer is ***Option 1: 2, 3 and 4.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1:** Indian captain Jasprit Bumrah broke Brian Lara's world record by scoring 32 runs in an over. This statement is incorrect.
 
• **Statement 2:** The world record stayed with Brian Lara for 18 years. This statement is correct.
 
• **Statement 3:** Brian Lara had hit South African left-arm spinner Robin Peterson for his record. This statement is correct.
 
• **Statement 4:** Jasprit Bumrah created a world record for maximum runs off a single over in Test cricket by hitting Stuart Broad for 35 runs.This statement is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Brian Lara's World Record:**__

 __
 
• Brian Lara's record for the most runs in a single over in Test cricket was set in 2003, when he scored 28 runs off an over from South African spinner Robin Peterson.
 
• This record stood for 18 years until it was broken by Jasprit Bumrah in 2022.
 
 
 
• **Jasprit Bumrah's Achievement:**__
 
 
• In July 2022, during a Test match at Edgbaston, Jasprit Bumrah scored 29 runs off Stuart Broad in a single over, with the over totaling 35 runs due to extras, thus setting a new world record.
 
• This remarkable feat highlighted Bumrah's versatility as a cricketer, demonstrating his prowess not just as a bowler but also as a capable batsman.
